VALUE_PROPS.body: Manufacturers always pay our attorney fees, or the representation is free. Clients of {{brand.name}} do not pay any fees, ever.

VALUE_PROPS.title: Buyback, Refund or Cash
VALUE_PROPS.body: We pursue a full repurchase, replacement, or cash settlement for your defective vehicle, whichever is best for you.

VALUE_PROPS.body: Lemon Law is a core of the practice, and we also take other consumer cases. We represent drivers across California.

PROCESS_STEPS.title: Check If You Qualify
PROCESS_STEPS.body: Answer a few questions about warranty timing and repairs to see whether California Lemon Law may apply.

PROCESS_STEPS.title: Estimate Your Recovery
PROCESS_STEPS.body: See a directional figure from cash price or lease total, minus the mileage offset.

PROCESS_STEPS.title: Build Your Case File
PROCESS_STEPS.body: Check off records you already have. Repair orders help most; we do not need a window sticker.

PROCESS_STEPS.title: We Take It From Here
PROCESS_STEPS.body: We pursue the manufacturer. You never pay our fees. You can call before you finish a tool or gather records.

QUALIFY_ITEMS: A defect that first occurred during the original manufacturer warranty.
The defect substantially impairs the vehicle's use, value, or safety.
The manufacturer has not fixed it after a reasonable number of repair attempts, or the vehicle spent extended time in the shop.
You do not need an 18-month / 18,000-mile timeline. That window is not required to have a case.

qualify.headline: California's Lemon Law may be on your side.
qualify.intro: Under the Song-Beverly Consumer Warranty Act, your new or used vehicle may qualify as a lemon if a warranted defect cannot be repaired in a reasonable number of attempts. What we care about most is whether the defect first occurred during the original manufacturer warranty:
qualify.recoveryNote: Directional estimate for a $52k SUV, first repair at ~9k miles. Taxes + incidentals included, mileage offset applied. Your situation will differ. The calculator shows yours live.

founder.headline: Built to make manufacturers pay.
paragraphs: The auto industry is represented by some of the largest defense firms in California. CLINE APC was created with one mission: aggressively force manufacturers to buy back defective vehicles. Lemon Law is a core of the practice, and we also take other consumer cases.

Attorney {founder} has been practicing law since 2006 and handling California Lemon Law since 2006. He opened CLINE APC in 2015 and has since secured recoveries against major manufacturers. Our team represents drivers statewide, from San Diego and Los Angeles to the Bay Area and Sacramento.
